parameters.name: Invert Left
parameters.description: Inverts the phase of the left audio channel
uses: Fix phase issues in left channel

parameters.name: Invert Right
parameters.description: Inverts the phase of the right audio channel
uses: Fix phase issues in right channel

parameters.name: Swap L/R
parameters.description: Exchanges left and right audio channels
uses: Test for phase issues (if sound changes, phase problem exists)

combinations.name: Both Inverted
combinations.result: Full polarity flip - sounds identical in isolation but affects phase when mixed with non-inverted signals

combinations.name: Left Only Inverted
combinations.result: Creates phase-based stereo effect, useful for stereo widening

combinations.name: Right Only Inverted
combinations.result: Creates phase-based stereo effect (opposite of left-only)

combinations.name: Swap + Invert
combinations.result: Complex stereo manipulation for advanced phase effects
